# org_lookup_tool

> Look up your place in the organization structure and find who to contact for help.

| | |
|---|---|
| Category | `organization` |
| Callable | MCP clients; in-app @ai conversations (default); grantable to agents |
| Filter | `https://www.dsiloed.com/api/v1/mcp?tools=org_lookup_tool` |

## Description

This is the description the server sends to the model, verbatim.

Look up your place in the organization structure and find who to contact for help.

USE THIS WHEN:
- You are stuck, blocked, or unsure and need to escalate to a human or another agent.
- You have work that should be handed to a subordinate (delegation).
- You want to know who you report to, or who reports to you.

ACTIONS:
- escalation_path (default): the ordered list of who to reach out to for help — your
  explicit escalation contacts first, then your management chain walked upward.
- find_help: same as escalation_path; pass an optional `topic` describing what you're
  stuck on (used to phrase your follow-up message — the contact list is unchanged).
- delegate (a.k.a. who_can_i_delegate_to): your subordinates to hand work to — direct
  reports first, then their reports. Pass an optional `topic` describing the work.
- who_do_i_report_to: your manager(s).
- my_team: your direct reports.
- find_person: name in, party_id out (humans and agents). Ids come from HERE, not from
  memories or old messages. `name` matches partially, case-insensitively.

INPUTS:
- action: one of escalation_path | find_help | delegate | who_do_i_report_to | my_team |
  find_person. Defaults to escalation_path.
- name: (find_person) who to look up.
- topic: (optional) what you need help with (find_help) or the work to hand off (delegate).
- agent_id: (optional) inspect another agent's org position instead of your own
  (e.g. a manager checking a report's chain). Defaults to you, the caller.

RETURNS: a list of contacts. Each contact has party_id, name, role, is_agent / is_human,
distance (1 = direct), and reachable_via. TO REACH/HAND OFF TO SOMEONE: message them with
start_dm_with_user_tool (reachable_via.party_id), @-mention them, or run them with
execute_agent_tool (agents only).

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `action` | string | no | What to look up. Defaults to escalation_path. One of: `escalation_path`, `find_help`, `delegate`, `who_can_i_delegate_to`, `who_do_i_report_to`, `my_team`, `find_person`. |
| `name` | string | no | find_person: the person or agent to look up (full or partial, case-insensitive). |
| `topic` | string | no | Optional: what you are stuck on (find_help) or the work to delegate (delegate). |
| `agent_id` | integer | no | Optional: inspect another agent's org position instead of your own. |
